Context: 1-B. 'Workplace' includes:-

- GID (25-K), Rule 3-C.  
5. Composition of the Complaints Committee.It should be headed by a woman and not less than half of its members should be women. To prevent the possibilities of any undue pressure or influence from senior levels, the committee should involve a third party, either NGO or other body who is familiar with the issue of sexual harassment.GID (25-C), Rule 3-C.
